title: OpenPath question file
description: One flow of questions shown one per screen by <openpath-flow>. Validated in the browser (shared/flow.js) and on the server against the same rules.

version.description: Version of this question file. Changing it discards progress saved in the browser for the old version.

flowId.description: Stable id for this flow. The API only accepts answers for flows it has loaded.

langCode.description: A language code: en, am, ar, or a code with a region such as pt-BR.

localized.description: Text in each language, keyed by language code. English is required; other languages fall back to English.

audioUrl.description: Audio file URL: http(s) or a path relative to the page. No other schemes (javascript:, data: ...).

audio.description: Recorded audio of the question for read-aloud, per language. Played instead of a synthetic voice; loaded only when played.

showIf.description: Only show this question when an earlier question's answer equals the value. For multi questions, the answer must include the value.

voice.description: Allow voice input for this question (not implemented yet).

autocomplete.description: HTML autocomplete token for text, phone and date questions, e.g. name, tel, bday.

multiline.description: Text questions only: show a multi-line box.

prefillFrom.description: Start with the learner's earlier answer to another flow's question (WCAG 3.3.7): "flowId.questionId", or a list tried in order. Not for private questions.

reuse.description: Keep this answer on the device after sending, so other flows can prefill it. The done screen says so and offers to forget it. Not for private questions.

country.description: Phone questions only. Default "ET": shows +251, accepts 09/07 local numbers and stores +251XXXXXXXXX. "any": free format, stored as typed.

calendar.description: Date questions only. "ethiopian" shows day, month and year lists in the Ethiopian calendar and stores { date: ISO Gregorian, ethiopian: { year, month, day } }. Default "gregorian" (stored as YYYY-MM-DD).

private.description: Sensitive answer: stored apart from the profile and left out of the openpath:complete event.

setsPreference.description: Multi questions only: copy the answer into the form's display preferences.
